joint_reporting_rules: Run after the complete 2560-call parent panel but regardless of its outcomes.
Use exactly the parent prompts for base indices 00 and 04 in every family.
Hash-randomize request order independently for each model in exact 16-cell factorial blocks.
Report every target, cross-effect, learner-need effect, cell mean, and interaction.
The replication can preserve or downgrade a parent-panel claim but cannot rescue one.
Call a factor order-robust only when both panels pass controllability and selectivity and every parent-subset and replication model effect is positive.
Do not replace failed calls, models, base problems, or factor cells after inspecting outcomes.
